legacy.needsAdmin: Cleaning up after the old version needs the helper service.

notice.firewallReset: The old strict mode had set Windows Firewall to block all outgoing traffic. It has been reset to Allow; protection now comes from the app's own filters.
notice.firewallAllowAll: Old kill switch rules were found without a record of the original settings. Outgoing traffic is allowed again in every Windows Firewall profile; check the firewall settings if you had changed them yourself.
notice.failedTitle: Cleanup after the old version is incomplete
notice.summary: Cleaned up: {{changed}}, failed: {{failed}}. Details are on the Maintenance page.

processes.skipped: Old engine processes were not checked

firewall.done: Windows Firewall settings of the old kill switch are cleaned up
firewall.skipped: Windows Firewall was left as is
